text: # Call Transcript: Number Porting Enquiry **Document ID:** TRX_004 **Category:** C06 — Number Portability (MNP) **Department:** Regulatory **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-06-18 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base **Channel:** Voice (Call Centre) --- ## Conversation Agent: NovaTel Sales, this is Arjun, how can I help? Customer: I want to port my number from another operator to NovaTel. Agent: Sure! First, please SMS 'PORT' followed by your 10-digit number to 1900 from that number. You'll receive a Unique Porting Code, or UPC. Customer: Okay, got it — it says PQR456. Agent: Great, that code is valid for 15 days. You can now visit any NovaTel store with this UPC and a valid ID proof to complete the porting request. Customer: How long before it's active? Agent: Typically 2 working days for porting within the same telecom circle, or 4 working days if it's a different circle. Customer: Perfect, thank you! Agent: I've also gone ahead and added a note on your account so if you contact us again about this, the team will have full context. Customer: Great, appreciate it. Agent: You're welcome — is there anything else I can help with today? Customer: No, that's everything. ## Diagnostic Notes (Internal) - Identity verified via registered number and OTP. - Relevant backend status checked before providing resolution timeline. - Case closed after customer confirmation; escalated only if unresolved beyond the stated SLA. ## Escalation This case required escalation to a specialist team after first-line troubleshooting did not resolve it
title: Number Porting Enquiry
